sources.title: LTX 10Eros - v1.4 | LTX Video Checkpoint | Civitai
sources.snippet: This model has near-0 anatomy depiction currently. It fully understands the concepts, but my new merge method is a 3 stage comparison shape-level reform lever that mostly aligns to the base 22b model instead of the usual merging methods. This is essentially an abliterated base LTX 2.3 model.
